title: Design System: Vida saludable en la adolescencia

display.purpose: Cover title only; condensed (wdth 88), uppercase, sized by container query so «ADOLESCENCIA» fits.

headline.purpose: Topic opener titles and the closing title; wide (wdth 112), uppercase.

title.purpose: Album-green subheads inside the reading column, sentence case.

lead.purpose: One-line intro under cover and opener titles, max 44ch.

label.purpose: Definition-list term labels (ficha, credits) and the album count; uppercase, wdth 130.

sticker-caption.purpose: Sticker names and numbers printed on the paper card.

shadows.name: sticker-lift
shadows.purpose: Stickers and the ficha card at rest: an object stuck onto the page.

shadows.name: button-hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Primary button on hover, paired with a 2px rise.

shadows.name: album-page-inset
shadows.purpose: Hairline edge of the green album page on the green cover.

motion.name: ease-album
motion.purpose: Expo-out ease for every transform: button lift, sticker paste, menu wipe, radio dot.

motion.name: paste-sticker
motion.purpose: New sticker drops from above (scale 1.22, -14deg), overshoots to .97 and settles at its rotation.

motion.name: shake-wrong
motion.purpose: Quiz panel shakes horizontally on a wrong answer.

motion.name: menu-wipe
motion.purpose: Mobile nav sheet reveals top to bottom.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Coral pill for the main action («Abrir el álbum», «Comprobar y pegar»).
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 28px; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: #FF806F; color: #0E2F2A; font: 800 1rem/1 Anybody, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-stretch: 120%; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 20px -12px rgb(14 47 42 / .6); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FF806F; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outlined pill for secondary actions on light grounds («Vaciar el álbum»).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 28px; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #164E45; font: 800 .9rem/1 Anybody, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-stretch: 120%; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .25s, color .25s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #0E2F2A; border-color: #0E2F2A; color: #F5F8F2; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FF806F; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-ghost[disabled] { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Numbered Topic Nav
components.description: Sticky green bar links with dashed number badges; pasted topics turn solid coral, current topic inverts.
components.html: 1Comer2Moverse3Dormir
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 6px; background: #164E45; padding: 12px; } .ds-nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 999px; text-decoration: none; font: 700 1rem/1.2 Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; color: rgb(245 248 242 / .88); transition: background-color .25s, color .25s; } .ds-nav a b { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1.5px dashed rgb(245 248 242 / .5); font: 900 .8rem/1 Anybody, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: rgb(245 248 242 / .1); color: #F5F8F2; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FF806F; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav a.is-pegada b { background: #FF806F; border: 1.5px solid #FF806F; color: #0E2F2A; } .ds-nav a[aria-current="true"] { background: #F5F8F2; color: #164E45; } .ds-nav a[aria-current="true"] b { border-color: #164E45; }

components.name: Album Slot (empty)
components.description: Dashed 3:4 numbered slot with a faint ghost of the sticker it is waiting for.
components.html: 3Dormir
components.css: .ds-page { background: #1D5C52; border-radius: 18px; padding: 24px; width: 180px; color: #F5F8F2; } .ds-slot { position: relative; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; display: grid; place-content: center; text-align: center; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; border: 2.5px dashed currentColor; border-radius: 10px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; opacity: .55; transition: opacity .25s, background-color .25s; } .ds-slot:hover { opacity: .9; background: rgb(245 248 242 / .06); } .ds-slot:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FF806F; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-slot__ghost { position: absolute; inset: 10% 14% 26%; display: grid; place-items: center; opacity: .14; filter: grayscale(1); } .ds-slot__ghost svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; } .ds-slot b, .ds-slot small { position: relative; } .ds-slot b { font: 900 3rem/1 Anybody, sans-serif; font-stretch: 130%; } .ds-slot small { font: 800 .7rem/1.2 Anybody, sans-serif; font-stretch: 110%; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Sticker (lámina)
components.description: Rotated paper sticker with art window, name, number and the fact plus its source.
components.html:
Moverse2
60 min de actividad al día · OMS
components.css: .ds-lamina { --r: -2deg; width: 150px; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0E2F2A; border-radius: 10px; padding: 7px; transform: rotate(var(--r)); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -10px rgb(0 0 0 / .45); } .ds-lamina__arte { flex: 1; min-height: 0; border-radius: 6px; display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; } .ds-lamina__arte svg { width: 62%; height: auto; } .ds-lamina__pie { padding: 7px 3px 1px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; } .ds-lamina__pie b { font: 900 .78rem/1.1 Anybody, sans-serif; font-stretch: 115%; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-lamina__pie span { font: 900 .78rem/1 Anybody, sans-serif; color: #A8402D; } .ds-lamina__fuente { display: block; padding: 0 3px; font: .62rem/1.2 Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #3F5C56; }

components.name: Special Sticker
components.description: Completion sticker: flat-printed coral star on album green, tilted -4deg.
components.html: Completo5/5
components.css: .ds-especial { width: 150px; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0E2F2A; border-radius: 10px; padding: 7px; transform: rotate(-4deg); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -10px rgb(0 0 0 / .45); } .ds-especial__arte { flex: 1; border-radius: 6px; background: #164E45; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-especial__arte svg { width: 70%; } .ds-especial__pie { padding: 7px 3px 1px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font: 900 .78rem/1.1 Anybody, sans-serif; font-stretch: 115%; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-especial__pie span { color: #A8402D; }

components.name: Quiz Panel
components.description: Green panel with one question, three paper option tiles with round radios, and the paste button.
components.html:

¡Correcto! Lámina 3 pegada.
components.css: .ds-quiz { max-width: 360px; background: #164E45; color: #F5F8F2; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-quiz fieldset { border: 0; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 18px; display: grid; gap: 10px; } .ds-quiz legend { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.08rem; line-height: 1.4; margin-bottom: 14px; padding: 0; } .ds-quiz label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0E2F2A; border: 2px solid transparent; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.35; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .2s; } .ds-quiz label:hover { border-color: #55BFA6; } .ds-quiz label:has(input:checked) { border-color: #164E45; } .ds-quiz label:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid #FF806F; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-quiz input { appearance: none; flex: none; width: 22px; height: 22px; margin: 0; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #3F5C56; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-quiz input:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-quiz input::after { content: ''; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #164E45; transform: scale(0); transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-quiz input:checked { border-color: #164E45; } .ds-quiz input:checked::after { transform: scale(1); } .ds-quiz__btn { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #FF806F; color: #0E2F2A; font: 800 1rem/1 Anybody, sans-serif; font-stretch: 120%; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-quiz__btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-quiz__btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FF806F; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-quiz__msg { margin-top: 14px; font-weight: 700; font-size: .98rem; color: #DDF1EA; }

components.name: Team Ficha
components.description: Leaf-white credits card on the cover, two columns split by a dashed hairline.
components.css: .ds-ficha { margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); max-width: 560px; background: #F5F8F2; color: #0E2F2A; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -10px rgb(0 0 0 / .45); } .ds-ficha > div { padding: 16px 20px; } .ds-ficha > div + div { border-left: 1px dashed #D5E1DA; } .ds-ficha dt { font: 800 .78rem/1.4 Anybody, sans-serif; font-stretch: 130%; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #A8402D; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-ficha dd { margin: 0; font: .98rem/1.45 Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The whole site is a sticker album. Deep album-green pages own the frame (the cover, each topic opener, the quiz panels), and the reading happens on calm leaf-white paper between them. Every healthy habit is a numbered lámina: an empty dashed slot with a faint ghost of its art until the reader answers the topic's question, then a white-bordered sticker, slightly rotated, pressed into place with a small physical "paste" motion. Completing all five earns a flat-printed special sticker (coral star, 5/5).

The voice is youthful but not childish: wide, heavy uppercase display (Anybody) does the shouting in short bursts, and a friendly humanist sans (Figtree) carries long, comfortable paragraphs. Colour lives in the frame and on the stickers; prose stays quiet. Progress is shown by marks and objects (slot vs sticker vs special sticker), never by a hue change alone.

Density is generous: one 68ch reading column per topic, a sticky quiz beside it on desktop, stacked on mobile. Nothing competes with the text while reading.
keyCharacteristics: Album-green frame, leaf-white reading paper, coral as the single hot accent.
Numbered dashed slots and rotated white-bordered stickers as the signature objects.
Wide uppercase Anybody display over Figtree body.
State as a mark, not a hue; every sticker prints its fact and source.
Pill buttons, softly rounded paper, one soft drop shadow reserved for stickers and the ficha.

rules.name: The Frame Owns the Colour Rule
rules.body: Saturated fields (green bands, coral wash) belong to the frame: cover, openers, quiz panels, closing page, footer. The reading column stays on leaf white with colour limited to album-green subheads and small coral idea marks.

rules.name: The Coral Is a Fill Rule
rules.body: Coral (#FF806F) carries ink text and is never itself text on leaf white or paper; use coral ink for that. Turquoise likewise is a fill or border, never text on a light ground.

rules.name: The Fit-the-Longest-Word Rule
rules.body: Big uppercase titles are sized by container query (cqi) against the column so the longest Spanish word never breaks or overflows; `text-wrap: balance` on every heading.

rules.name: The Short-Bursts Rule
rules.body: Anybody is for titles, labels, buttons and sticker print only. Paragraphs, legends and messages are always Figtree.

rules.name: The Only Objects Cast Shadows Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this is a thing stuck onto the page" (sticker, ficha). Panels and bands never get one.

dos: Do show progress as a change of object (dashed numbered slot → rotated paper sticker → special sticker), not as a recolour.
Do print the fact and its source on every sticker («400 g de frutas y verduras al día · OMS»), and keep the full fact in the prose.
Do keep reading columns on leaf white at max 68ch, Figtree 1.125rem/1.7.
Do use coral ink (#A8402D) whenever coral must be text on a light ground.
Do alternate album green and album page green between consecutive green bands.
Do size big uppercase titles by container query so the longest word fits.
Do honour reduced motion: the paste, shake and menu wipe all collapse to instant.
donts: Don't use a photo hero or a card grid of topics; the album is the structure.
Don't put facts in stat panels or big-number callouts; they live in the prose and on the sticker.
Don't let the album take over the reading column; it lives on the cover, the topic openers and the closing page.
Don't set turquoise or plain coral as text on leaf white or paper.
Don't give flat panels or bands a drop shadow; only pasted objects cast one.
Don't set paragraphs, legends or messages in Anybody.
